scope: Every requested layout is instantiated in its native-selected original scene, rendered after actual water-front propagation, inspected, moved/undone where possible, and its saved solution is applied. Simulation uses timeScale=10 and restores the original value; native delayed events and the 51-frame victory poll remain active. Preview boards without counted targets require separate successful normal gameplay evidence. Original binary equivalence is a separate assessment.
